Sarta Garluses (Japanese: , Sātin Garuusu) are four Quest Exclusive Bosses in . They are members of the Garlus family, and are fought at level 43 at the Pillar City Ruins in the Kingdom of Tantal during Fly in the Ointment.

Samon (Japanese: , Samon) is a Nopon in . He is a mechanic from the City who is first found at the Sentridge Harbor Control at the Great Sword's Base, where he builds the Boundary for the party to be able to traverse the Erythia Sea, and later helps the party reach Origin by upgrading the Boundary into the Bravery. He is later found at Mxene Tech Quarter in the City. As the leader of the Seven Legendary Nopon who wield the Ultimate Hammers, he can be spoken to in order to perform Blade Upgrades for the party after completing Uniting the Seven Nopon.
Saoru is an NPC and in and can be found in Colony 15, and later in the City. Later on, he can be found on the City's Mitia Lookout.

Sesna Lexos (Japanese: , Sesuta Rekusosu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of Lexos family, and can be found at level 47 flying around Bagnar Snowfield at Valak Mountain during the day. It may be necessary to lure them over solid ground to bring them within reach of the party's short-range attacks, as well as to ensure the dropped chest will be accessible. One of them must be defeated for Monster Quest 4. They can drop the Silver Lexos Hearts needed for I Want to be a Homs!.

Shaking Icicles is a Merc Group mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal by speaking to Ioannis in the Residential Area, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Superstrength" and "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills.
Shackle Arts is a Status Effect in and . It prevents the affected character from using any Arts. The debuff can be guarded against through use of the Star Necklace and Moon Necklace Accessories.

Sensational Gigapur (Japanese: , Akakaminari no Gigasuparu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Fogbeast Laia, and can be found at level 47 flying around Gravina Bridge on the Black Mountains during Red Lightning.

The Shackles of Samaar, also known as the Spears of Samaar, are important objects in . They are six giant spear-like mechanisms embedded in the islands of Volitaris, each containing a small database on the ancient Samaarians. The main function of the shackles is to bind Void's power. The party can activate the shackles so that they can pierce Void's body.

Snow Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Vague Barbas at Nagul Waterfall, and by Reef Nebula in Valak Mountain. These nebulas can easily be found at the Nofol Tower on Valak Mountain at night. One can be found near Jakt Geyser and another at the entrance to the Sealed Tower during the day. According to their description, they are ice elements that turn rain into snow when thrown in the air. Two are required for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 5,700 Noponstones.
Sister Seals (Japanese: , Fūin no Shimaimon) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is automagically received along with Path to Prison Island while travelling through the Eryth Sea.

The Skyray (Japanese: , An'noun, Unknown) is a quest exclusive boss in . It is a member of the Laia family that is found at level 40 on the Central Seal Island of Eryth Sea during the Story Quest Path to Prison Island, once started along with Sister Seals. The Skyray does not drop or carry any treasure.

Skells (from the word exoskeleton; Japanese: , Dōru, Doll; English dub: ) are weaponizable mechs in . Skells rely on fuel to power them, and can be used in battle at any time, mostly against larger creatures. The party may only acquire a Skell after Chapter 6, with the flight pack available after Chapter 9. Only BLADE members with a Skell License are allowed to use them. Skells have breakable parts (such as one losing its arm in battle) that will prevent them from using certain weapons until the damage is repaired. All Skell models can transform into different types of vehicles, such as the Formula Skell transforming into a motorcycle-like vehicle. Some Skells can also transform into an arme

Shuravas, the Enraged (Japanese: , Fundo no Shuravasu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Millepod family. It can be found at level 65 in Noctilum at Suncatch Ravine during thunderstorms. Damaging Shuravas, the Enraged's weak back fin immediately causes it to become Enraged. Destroying its back fin increases its Enraged level, causes it to gain a beam-attribute proximity spike, and makes its Arts more powerful.

Sidearm Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Six Stars Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Lend an Ear, alongside the Buxom Battlers holofigure. The Sidearm weapons available in-game are: * Devastator Sidearm * Foxfire Sidearm * Rectifier Sidearm * Rugged Sidearm * Sparrow Sidearm

Sparas Paguls (Japanese: , Suparasu Pagūru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Pagul family and can be found at level 42 on the icy pond at the bottom of Nagul Waterfall on Valak Mountain. Five of them must be defeated for Valak Mountain's Monster Quest 2. They are the only source of Pagul Cold Pies, three of which are needed for the Colony 6 quest A Tantalising Treat.

Sol Gradies are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Grady family, and can be found in the water around various islands and shorelines of the Eryth Sea, including the western shore of the island housing the Hode Refuge and swimming around Sleeping Dragon Isle. They are counterparts to the Lunar Gradies also found in Eryth Sea and, contrary to what their names imply, can be found at any time of day.

Starfall Basin (Japanese: , Ryūsei no Tani) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, at the southwesternmost part of the continent. During the prologue, Elma discovers Cross in a cryogenic stasis pod here before handing them a Proto Assault Rifle and taking them back to New Los Angeles. If it is visited later in the game, there is a mix of low and higher levelled enemies. FN Site 102 is also located here. The site is later revisited during the Affinity Mission The Repair Job, in order to salvage three L-002 Power Cables from White Whale debris.
